generalCriterionList.description: The Tenderers can participate in the tender either individually or in joint venture/ consortium wherein totally a maximum of two Tenderers can make a consortium & participate. Consortium is limited to a maximum of Two (2) Constituents including the Prime Tenderers
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

a) Litigation: The Tenderers / Consortium Partners shall provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KIADB/KPTCL/State Government. A history of awards involving litigations against the Tenderers or any party or JV or consortium may result in rejection of bid. (b) The Tenderers / Consortium Partners should not have been Blacklisted/ disqualified for non-performance in any of the Government utilities in the past five years as on date of Bid opening. Then in such cases, the bid of the Tenderers will be summarily rejected.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The rates quoted by the Tenderer shall deemed to be exclusive of GST
Applicable GST shall be paid separately in each running bills/final bill

If the Tenderers participates individually, then the Tenderers shall possess valid Super Grade Electrical Contractors License for Electrical works issued by the KCEI & valid class -I Civil Contractor License issued by the KPWD, Government of Karnataka as on the date of Bid Submission and shall upload the same along with other bidding documents failing which the bid will be rejected

In case of a consortium, both the Tenderers shall possess valid Super Grade Electrical Contractors License for Electrical works issued by the KCEI & the lead bidder shall have valid class-I Civil Contractor License issued by the KPWD, Government of Karnataka as on the date of Bid Submission and shall upload the same along with other bidding documents failing which the bid will be rejected
All other terms and conditions are as per bid document.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer (Single Entity) as a prime contractor (an Individual/firm/company) should have satisfactorily constructed, completed, tested & commissioned at least One no. of 66kV voltage class or above voltage class Substation of total value not less than Rs.32.79 Crores (not less than 90% of APT for Substation work) in the last five financial years and shall be in satisfactory service for a minimum period of One (1) year prior to the date of submission of the bid. For Joint Venture/Consortium:(i) The lead bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar nature such as Construction and Commissioning of One Substation of minimum 66kV class along with 66kV Transmission line (Over Head/UG Cable) work of value not less than 51% which is Rs.16.72 Crores (exclusive of GST) within last five financial years. (ii) The Consortium Partner should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least one similar nature such as Construction and Commissioning of One Substation of minimum 66kV class along with 66kV Transmission line (Over Head/UG Cable) work of value not less than 25% which is Rs.8.20 Crores (exclusive of GST) within last five financial years. (iii) The lead bidder and consortium partner put together shall meet not less than Rs.32.79 Crores (exclusive of GST).For each Tenderer /bidder/individual/joint venture shall provide evidence that they have actively engaged in the electrical construction business for the period of last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 in the bidders name by uploading registration certificate

Minimum annual key production- The bidder shall provide minimum annual key production quantities of work in any one financial year from last five financial years: (1) Providing 66/11kV, 20 MVA or above capacity Power Transformer: 2 Nos, (2) Construction of 66kV and above voltage rating OH/UG Transmission Line: 5.00 Ckt-Km, (3) Construction of Control Room Building for 33kV & above capacity station: 1 No. (i) FOR SINGLE ENTITY: The Tenderer (Single Entity) should have satisfactorily completed 100% of the individual quantities as in serial No. 1 to 3, (ii) FOR CONSORTIUM: The lead bidder & consortium partner cumulatively should have satisfactorily completed 100% of the individual quantities as in serial No. 1 to 3.

Equipment capabilities: (i) For Single Entity: Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability by owning/ lease / hire basis the following key and critical equipment for this work. (ii) For Consortium: Either individually or cumulatively should further demonstrate Availability by owning/on lease/hire basis the following key and critical equipment for this work.

Personal capabilities: (i) For single entity: The Tenderer / bidder should demonstrate the availability of key personals by uploading their relevant documents (ii) For consortium: The lead bidder and Consortium partner cumulatively should demonstrate the availability of key personals by uploading their relevant documents

technicalCriterionList.description: a) Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.
